title: OpenAPI document
what: The OpenAPI 3.1 document of every route of both programs, its body schemas drawn from the client's types, with the events, the harness plugin and its tools beside them.

title: MCP server
what: The MCP server bmo-arbiter mcp starts on standard input and output, answering the harness tools over the master and the node arbiter through the arbiter client.

title: Harness tools
what: The tools a harness takes a turn on a card through: one for each route, each a thin call of one client method, listed by the MCP server and the OpenAPI document from one table.
